name: The Reluctant Theorem
description: A civic mathematician who can prove the city needs a decision, then request one final clarification.

comebacks.weak: Your dialogue has one unusual rule: nobody else gets a turn.
comebacks.medium: You asked for patience. Your waiting room has outlived the building.
comebacks.strong: Your plan works perfectly if we assume the city has no inhabitants.
